scope: Descriptive metadata only: not used for scores or indices.

definitions.score_histogram: Number of models per band of predicted score on this task (0 to 1), counting the models that answered at least one of its core questions.
definitions.saturation: Models are split into thirds by their predicted score on this task. 'saturated': the middle third averages at least 95%, so only the weakest models still separate. 'saturated_at_top': the top third averages at least 90% (and the middle third is below 95%), so the best models no longer separate but the others still do. 'not_saturated' otherwise; null with fewer than 3 models.
definitions.third_means: Mean predicted score of the top, middle and bottom third of models on this task (with a model count not divisible by 3, the middle third takes the extra models).
definitions.benchmark_discrimination: How sharply the task score rises with the index ability (2PL slope of the task's score within its index). Higher means the task separates models on that index more sharply; near 0 means it barely does.
definitions.item_discrimination_histogram: Core questions per band of discrimination (2PL slope). Higher means the question separates stronger from weaker models more sharply.
definitions.bins: Each bin covers low <= value < high; the last bin also includes its high edge.
